Echoes of an Era (1982) – Jazz All-Star Collaboration

An outstanding jazz vocal and fusion recording featuring an incredible lineup of musicians:

  • Chaka Khan – Vocals
  • Chick Corea – Piano
  • Stanley Clarke – Bass
  • Freddie Hubbard – Trumpet
  • Joe Henderson – Tenor Saxophone
  • Lenny White – Drums

Released on Elektra Records in 1982, this album combines classic jazz standards with the talents of some of the most influential jazz musicians of the era.

Album Information

  • Artist: Echoes of an Era
  • Title: Echoes of an Era
  • Label: Elektra Records
  • Catalog Number: E1-60021
  • Format: LP, 33 RPM, Stereo
  • Year: 1982
